mentions.name: HarborGit
mentions.description: This is a Git GUI client built as a replacement for the Tower Git GUI. It uses a one-time purchase, perpetual licensing model with support guaranteed for a year; upgrading to a future major version requires buying a new perpetual license, with no mandatory subscription.
mentions.problem: The author's preferred Git GUI, Tower, moved to a monthly subscription model for newer versions, so they have stayed on Tower 2 for nearly a decade and wanted a one-time-purchase alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: Been working on a replacement for my Git GUI of choice, Tower, for the last few months. I've been using Tower 2 for almost a decade now, refusing the monthly subscription to upgrade to a fresher version. I'm going to keep mine a one time purchase with support guaranteed for a year.
